# gitmoap_group_push_rules (Resource)

Saves the group's own values for the rules you send, creating them if it has none; `null` clears a rule. The body takes only the rules it lists, and a field it does not list is refused rather than ignored. Groups and repositories beneath inherit them. Maintainers and above may change them; enforcing them, or changing them once enforced, needs an Owner, and enforced rules hold for everything beneath: a rule turned on stays on, a file-size limit caps any larger one, and a pattern replaces those set beneath.

The token needs `push_rule:manage` and `push_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `author_email_regex` (String)
- `commit_message_regex` (String)
- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.
- `max_file_size_mb` (Number)
- `prohibited_file_names_regex` (String)
- `reject_unsigned_commits` (Boolean)
- `require_closing_issue_reference` (Boolean)
- `require_issue_reference` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id.
terraform import gitmoap_group_push_rules.example "<group_id>"
```
